title: Evidence of one check run
description: design/evidence/<sha256>.json (#3148, ws-082): the result of one run of one contract's check, named for the SHA-256 of the file's bytes. chant workspace records new writes it from the fields, as JSON with two-space indents and a final newline, and it never changes afterwards. A work item cites it as evidence for a criterion by its path and hash (chant workspace work evidence --path). The fields are the ones studio's factory writes (arugula-salad/studio#47), so evidence written before this kind reads as it.

contract.description: The contract checked, and its digest when the check ran: the digest chant workspace records --json prints for the contract record (the SHA-256 of its text without its reviews block). Evidence studio's factory wrote before this kind carries the contract's approved_sha there.

check_sha.description: The SHA-256 of the check file that ran. The contract's checks pin it by the same hash.

check.description: The check file that ran, from the workspace root. Optional.

commit.description: The commit tested, or null when the working tree was tested and differed from HEAD in the app or the check.

tree.description: The git tree id of the app as tested. With contract.sha it names what the evidence is about: a release accepts evidence for the tree its commit holds.

work.description: The work item the run checked, when it ran under one's lease. Optional.

lease.description: The fencing token of the work lease the run held, which joins the evidence to the run record and to the commits that carry the same Chant-Lease trailer (ws-075). Optional.

runner.description: Who ran the check: a kind, such as factory-check for studio's factory, and the runner's name and version.

ok.description: Whether the check passed: it exited 0, ran at least one test, and left no criterion unchecked.

tests.description: How many tests ran, not counting skipped ones. A check that ran none is not evidence.

criteria.description: The result per acceptance criterion, keyed by the contract's criterion id (a1, a2, ...): pass, fail, or unchecked when no test named after it ran.

output.description: The tail of the check's output, at most 6000 characters.

at.description: When the run ended, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

structural.description: Checks of the contract's references (design assets a criterion is checked against): for each referenced section, each route, element and text it declares, and whether the running app has it. Their results count toward criteria. Optional.

problem.description: Why nothing was checked: the section is missing, or declares nothing.

target.description: The route, the CSS selector, or the text.

page.description: The page an element or text was looked for on.

source.description: Where what was checked came from, when a builder made it (#2708): how the record was written (via), the builder's harness, its model and its conversation (session). chant checks the shapes of the fields it knows.

gitId.description: A full git object id: 40 hex digits, or 64 in a SHA-256 repository.
